_note: App Store captions, one entry per shot, in order. `file` is the raw capture's stem from the demo harness (.e2e-artifacts/appstore/<lang>/). Keep them short and specific: this is the product's voice, not a campaign. `dot` is a status colour (DESIGN §9) — the same language the app uses, carried onto the store page.

en.title: See which agent needs you
en.sub: Red waits for you; cyan is working; green is idle.

en.title: Alerts on your Lock Screen
en.sub: Get a notification when an agent needs you. Live Activities show its state.

en.title: Reply from your phone
en.sub: Read the terminal and answer its question with buttons.

en.title: HQ tracks other sessions
en.sub: Review what changed while you were away.

en.title: Ask HQ for an update
en.sub: Its replies and recorded actions share one conversation.

en.title: See your usage
en.sub: Check each plan window and when it resets.

en.title: Switch between your Macs
en.sub: Your MacBook, the studio Mac, even one a teammate shares.

zh.title: 谁在等你
zh.sub: 红色表示等你处理，青色表示运行中，绿色表示空闲。

zh.title: 锁屏提醒
zh.sub: agent 需要你时收到通知，实时活动显示当前状态。

zh.title: 在手机上回复
zh.sub: 查看终端内容，用按钮回答 agent 的问题。

zh.title: HQ 帮你盯进度
zh.sub: 它汇总各个会话的变化，提醒你处理等待中的事。

zh.title: 向 HQ 问进度
zh.sub: 它的回复和已执行的操作在同一段对话里。

zh.title: 查看用量
zh.sub: 各个额度窗口的用量和重置时间都在这里。

zh.title: 在几台 Mac 之间切换
zh.sub: 你的笔记本、工作室那台，还有同事分享给你的。

ipad-en.title: Every agent, and the one you open
ipad-en.sub: The list stays in the sidebar while the session fills the rest.

ipad-en.title: HQ beside your calls
ipad-en.sub: Talk to HQ while what is waiting on you stays in view.

ipad-en.title: Every pane, in one view
ipad-en.sub: Sessions as cards, agents and plain shells alike, searchable.

ipad-en.title: Browse HQ's knowledge
ipad-en.sub: Choose an entry on the left; read it and manage it on the right.

ipad-zh.title: 谁在干活，谁在等你
ipad-zh.sub: 侧栏是所有 agent，打开的会话占满右边。

ipad-zh.title: HQ 就在该你拍板的事旁边
ipad-zh.sub: 和 HQ 说话时，等你的事一直在眼前。

ipad-zh.title: 所有窗格，一屏看完
ipad-zh.sub: 会话是卡片，agent 和普通终端都在，能搜。

ipad-zh.title: 并排查看知识库
ipad-zh.sub: 从左侧选条目，在右侧查看内容和操作。
